runner.relationship_to_wexp: Outside project. Not an implementation of WEXP Core-02, and not a contributor to wexp-check or wexp-ref. This is a replay of the published procedure on their code, nothing more.
runner.method: three local checkouts in /tmp, per REPRODUCE.md, no virtualenv, no packages installed
runner.working_directory: The last two commands were run from /tmp/wexp-check. That is not incidental: the driver line passes '.' as the baseline checkout and the two /tmp paths as the reference trees, so the working directory has to be the wexp-check checkout and the other two clones have to sit at /tmp/wexp-ref and /tmp/wexp-vectors for the recorded command to resolve.

commands_as_run: git clone https://github.com/WEXP-dev/wexp-ref.git && git -C wexp-ref checkout 56289024c9ee748111f1f1d4f42728ffe04d8d69
git clone https://github.com/WEXP-dev/wexp-vectors.git && git -C wexp-vectors checkout edd67056873502a2c3cecf5dd2b8db71271c2f57
commands_as_run_notes: These are the commands as typed, in the order typed, with the clones made inside /tmp so that the two /tmp reference paths in line 5 resolve; line 5 was run from /tmp/wexp-check.
Line 1 does no checkout: wexp-check was cloned at the default branch, whose head was cfe458b5 on 2026-11-19, and that head is what the pin above records. No explicit checkout of wexp-check was run.
Lines 4 and 5 are the ones whose output is recorded in 'results'.
commands_for_a_replay: git clone https://github.com/WEXP-dev/wexp-check.git && git -C wexp-check checkout cfe458b5f90c0a95ad1723b7a0dbba1b8d834fae
git clone https://github.com/WEXP-dev/wexp-ref.git && git -C wexp-ref checkout 56289024c9ee748111f1f1d4f42728ffe04d8d69
git clone https://github.com/WEXP-dev/wexp-vectors.git && git -C wexp-vectors checkout edd67056873502a2c3cecf5dd2b8db71271c2f57
cd wexp-check && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests
commands_for_a_replay_notes: These are instructions for someone repeating the run elsewhere, not commands I ran. In particular the explicit 'git -C wexp-check checkout <sha>' in the second line is a replay step: my run cloned at the default head and did not check anything out.

They differ from the run in two ways on purpose: an explicit working directory at the start, and explicit ../wexp-ref style absolute paths for the reference trees, so the block can be pasted and expect to work from a clean shell.
The paths inside 'commands_for_a_replay' are illustrative; a replay's output will differ in the paths it prints, which is why the row-level comparison, not the file hash, is the check that matters.

results.note: Both sets' per-case rows equal those in this repository's comparison.json. The file differs from the repository copy only in the engines block and the python patch level.

comparison.json.source: Output of the driver line above, unedited. Its 'engines' block records the engine modules as resolved inside each checkout - 'wexp_check/__init__.py' and 'wexp_ref/core02/appraiser.py' - so those are module-relative paths, not checkout directories, and they will read the same on any machine. The absolute import paths, the ones that carry this machine's /tmp layout, are printed to stdout only and are not stored in the file. The 'python' field records the interpreter patch level, 3.12.11 here against 3.12.13 in the repository copy.

README.md.source: written for this record; revised 2026-11-24 after the maintainer's review to state the working directory and the engine-path wording

limits: One machine, one run, one operator: this does not become independent implementation provenance.
The wexp-check and wexp-ref code was written by the same operator; replaying it on a third machine does not separate the two implementations.
No GitHub Actions run: this was a local checkout, so no run URL is available to cite.
